verdict.rationale: Adyen documents offering payment links, and its official MCP server (Alpha) exposes create/get/expire payment-link tools an agent can call against the API. The evidence shows no first-class product or price objects to provision first. The Product Feed API syncs inventory to AI platforms, which is a different capability from billing catalog objects. Missing for 10: API-provisionable product objects, API-provisionable price objects, evidence of an end-to-end product→price→link flow in one agent session, and hands-on corroboration.
